LocalizedDetails.Name: AI Prompt Injection Indicators
LocalizedDetails.Description: Detects text that addresses an AI assistant rather than a human reader, in any of fourteen languages, including payloads hidden in invisible formatting.

Resource.Name: AI Prompt Injection Indicators
Resource.Description: Text that addresses an AI assistant rather than a human reader: instructions to override prior directions, to conceal information from the user, to adopt a new role, or raw chat-protocol delimiters. Covers fourteen languages plus language-neutral product names. Detects payloads regardless of whether they are visible, because Purview inspects extracted text.
